title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 39
text:
Policy Conditions Example
• Schedule of locations already entered
• Underwriter is coding 250M EQ policy (50% participation) that has
• 50M sublimit for locations in California subject to a 15% deductible
• An underlying 10M sublimit for locations in LA county
• Both conditions are sublimits since they limit coverage for a subset of 
locations
• 10M sublimit for LA county is a sub -condition of the 50M California condition 
since it provides even more limited coverage to a subset of locations
